projects.name: Project Portfolio
details: Delivered three major Citi programs focused on regulatory compliance, cross-border governance, and
financial system enablement — including KSA RHQ Entity Enablement, Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
Modernization, and FINRA Compliance Automation ensuring governance, audit readiness, and regulatory
alignment across multiple regions (KSA, China, Asia).
• KSA RHQ Entity Onboarding – Set up new legal entity and regulatory framework for Citi’s KSA
operations under MISA & CBAT compliance.
The KSA RHQ Entity Enablement Project was initiated under a Saudi regulatory directive requiring
Citibank to establish a Regional Headquarters legal entity and secure a MISA license. The initiative
complied with CBAT (Cross-Border Approval & Transparency) processes and involved enabling and
validating critical financial systems — APS, FFS, PERL, GENESIS, P2P, and eRECON — ensuring
seamless integration, data integrity, and operational independence of the new entity.
• FINRA Compliance Automation - Automated onboarding and review process for non-employee
compliance validation.
The FINRA Compliance Automation Project focused on automating compliance governance and
onboarding processes for eligible non-employees across the Asia region. The project focused on
implementing technology-driven solutions to automate the onboarding and compliance review
process.
• Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization – Modernized procurement and financial workflow for Citi
China entities.
The Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization Project was executed as part of Citi’s global P2P program
to expand procurement and finance operations in China. It involved the setup of two new legal
entities, Citi Securities and Citi Futures Company, regulatory approvals, and system integration
across Fullsuite, PEARL, and S2, including implementation of GL and FA modules. The project
adopted a dual-cycle testing strategy — pre– and post–regulatory approval — to ensure compliance,
audit readiness, and localization of financial operations.
• Led end-to-end project lifecycle, covering initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and
closure across multiple Citi workstreams.
• Defined project scope, milestones, budgets, and resource plans ensuring timely and cost- efficient delivery.
• Oversaw PTS-based project tracking, milestone adherence, and RAID management (Risks,
Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
• Collaborated with Citi PMO, Compliance, Legal, and Finance teams for regulatory approvals
and governance reviews.
• Managed UAT cycles, test evidence, and release documentation ensuring audit readiness
and regulatory compliance.
• Coordinated across onshore–offshore teams (India, Singapore, China, and KSA) for seamless
execution and alignment.
• Reported project status, risks, and dependencies to senior Citi stakeholders and leadership
committees.
• Facilitated all Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and
Retrospectives ensuring disciplined Agile delivery.
• Partnered with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define, refine, and prioritize product
backlogs.
• Removed impediments, improved sprint flow, and maintained transparency between
development, QA, and business teams.
• Promoted cross-functional collaboration, accountability, and sprint goal ownership across
distributed Agile teams.
Earlier Professional Experience
Infosys (Client: US Healthcare)
